{{Quote|Bringing up the rear was ''Chatter''. He got his n-name due to his love of code-breaking, and because he never shuts up.|Sergeant Marrt|<ref name="Tale" />}}
'''Chatter''' was the name of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] with the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[182nd Legion]]. During the early years of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he participated in a [[Scout/Legends|reconnaissance]] [[Mission to Belgaroth|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belgaroth]], along with fellow [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] [[Recon]], [[Knuckles (182nd Legion)|Knuckles]], and [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Marrt]]. The [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] were dispatched to the planet in order to investigate claims that the local [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Czerka factory]] was secretly trading with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the course of the mission, Chatter, Recon, and Knuckles were all [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[droidbreaker]]&mdash;a creature indigenous to Belgaroth&mdash;leaving Marrt to complete the mission alone, which he successfully did.

==Biography==
{{Quote|It's chewing on his blaster&hellip;It's ''CHEWING'' on his ''BLASTER! PUT THAT DOWN, YA FILTHY BEAST!|Chatter, losing his temper after Recon's death|<ref name="Tale" />}}
Chatter was the name<ref name="Tale" /> of one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] bred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Databank" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Chatter served with the [[182nd Legion]], a unit of the Grand Army, and earned his nickname for his talkative personality and love of code-breaking.<ref name="Tale" /> At some point during the [[22 BBY/Legends|first]] [[21 BBY/Legends|two years]] of the conflict,<ref name="A Trooper's Tale date" /> Chatter and three other [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]&mdash;[[Knuckles (182nd Legion)|Knuckles]], [[Recon]], and [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Marrt]]&mdash;were dispatched to the planet [[Belgaroth]] on a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] [[Mission to Belgaroth|mission]]. The clones were to investigate claims that a local [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Czerka factory|weapons factory]] run by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] corporation was clandestinely selling arms to the Republic's enemy, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Tale" />

[[File:Chatter_death.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Chatter, moments before his death]]
After the clones landed on the planet with a [[Dropship/Legends|dropship]] and made their way to the factory, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Marrt went inside to investigate, while the rest of the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] remained in hiding. Marrt discovered that the man in charge of the facility, [[Tarin (Human)|Tarin]], was meeting with [[Reep Tonith]], a representative of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], which was allied with the Confederacy. The two were discussing a shipment of illegal [[FEX-M3 nerve gas grenade]]s to the Confederacy. Marrt took one of the [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] as evidence and tried to return to his squad undetected, but he was spotted, and Tonith's [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] opened fire, forcing all four clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to fall back to a swamp. Chatter attempted to contact Republic headquarters but was unable to do so, because the fog that stood over the swamp was interfering with the clones' equipment.<ref name="Tale" />

At that point, the clones heard a strange screech, which Knuckles mistook for the sound of approaching battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Recon corrected him, saying that the sound was emitted by something big, but he was then suddenly attacked by a native [[droidbreaker]] creature. The droidbreaker hit Recon, throwing him into a [[Tree/Legends|tree]], and the trooper [[Death/Legends|died]] upon impact. Witnessing the creature chewing on Recon's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], Chatter frantically started firing his own weapon. He was unable to hit anything because of the fog, and Marrt ordered him to cease fire. Realizing that they were standing in the creature's natural habitat, the clone troopers understood that they had to leave the swamp as quickly as possible. Before they could so, however, the droidbreaker attacked again, catching Chatter off-guard and killing him. Moments later, Knuckles met his end as well, but Marrt was able to kill the creature by using the confiscated nerve grenade. After burying his fallen squadmates under the creature's severed head, Marrt proceeded to attack the Czerka factory alone. He burned the facility, retrieved valuable data, and took Tarin into custody, although Reep Tonith escaped.<ref name="Tale" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|&hellip;and the droid says, "That's why I always ask for ''guard'' duty!"|Chatter, delivering the punchline for a joke|<ref name="Tale" />}}
The trooper's tendency to talk a lot and his love of code-breaking earned him the nickname "Chatter." During the mission to Belgaroth, Chatter was talkative as always and was cracking jokes while on the way to the Czerka factory, much to Knuckles' amusement. After Recon's death, however, there was no trace of Chatter's joyful nature as he fell into a frenzy and opened fire at the droidbreaker.<ref name="Tale" /> As a clone of Jango Fett, Chatter had the same height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] as his genetic template.<ref name="Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chatter's only appearance to date was in ''[[A Trooper's Tale]]'', a short [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] strip published in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.8|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic UK 6.8]]'' in [[May]] of [[2010]]. ''A Trooper's Tale'' was written by [[Robin Etherington]] and illustrated by [[Andres Ponce]].<ref name="Tale" />
